user.title: Marstek BLE
user.description: Home Assistant scans the currently known connectable BLE devices, including Bluetooth proxies. CT002 and Venus devices can be selected from the list; a MAC address can still be entered manually. CT002 polling defaults to 5 seconds.

data_description.ct_mac: Detected CT002 units appear as MST-TPM_… with their Bluetooth MAC. The MAC can be entered manually if needed.
data_description.venus_devices: Select multiple detected Venus devices. Each selected device can then be named individually.
data_description.ct_poll_interval: Default and recommended: 5 s. Allowed: 1 to 300 s.
data_description.venus_poll_interval: Default: 150 s. Each cycle reads all selected Venus devices sequentially.

confirm_fast_poll.title: Confirm fast CT002 polling
confirm_fast_poll.description: You selected {seconds} seconds. Below {recommended} seconds, BLE and device load increase significantly and some CT002 units may become unstable. The integration deliberately does not impose a higher minimum. Submit to confirm that you want to use this interval at your own risk.

error.invalid_mac: At least one Bluetooth MAC address is invalid.
error.empty_name: The name must not be empty.

init.title: Marstek BLE options
init.description: Home Assistant shows detected Venus devices from the Bluetooth manager, including proxies. Already configured devices remain selectable even when they are not currently seen. The integration reloads automatically after saving.

data_description.ct_poll_interval: Default and recommended: 5 s. Allowed: 1 to 300 s.
data_description.venus_poll_interval: Default: 150 s. One poll reads all selected Venus devices sequentially.
data_description.venus_devices: Select, add, or remove devices. Each selected device can then be named individually.

confirm_fast_poll.title: Confirm fast CT002 polling
confirm_fast_poll.description: You selected {seconds} seconds. Below {recommended} seconds, BLE and device load increase significantly and some CT002 units may become unstable. The integration deliberately does not impose a higher minimum. Submit to confirm that you want to use this interval at your own risk.

error.invalid_mac: At least one Venus Bluetooth MAC address is invalid.
error.empty_name: The name must not be empty.
